hero.title: Hello everyone!
hero.description: My name is Ekaterina. Still a beginner front-end developer, but for now. Let's get acquainted!

about.title: Ekaterina Kalneus
about.subtitle: Everyone starts somewhere...
about.text1: Graduate of Physics Department of NSU. Started with JavaScript on Stepic, interned at Itransition, spoke at Lomonosov-2023 conference, actively volunteered.
about.text2: During my studies, I learned Python, C, C++, React. Participated in Comptech winter school. Worked as a lab assistant at MTC SB RAS.
about.text3: Now I'm actively improving my skills, working as an engineer at PISH NSU and looking for my dream job in web development.
